messages:
maya: Heads up — uploaded a new mock for the trace pane compact / timeline collapse mode. https://figma.redwood/tracepane/v3 (please review)
maya: Main asks: stack trace density when collapsed, correlation ID visibility, export button placement, keyboard & screen reader behavior. Quick thoughts?
jonah: Looks solid overall. one implementation concern: when collapsed we truncate frames — need a clear affordance to expand per-frame. suggest a chevron with aria-expanded toggling.
priya: +1 on affordance. copy tweak: change 'Show frames' -> 'Expand stack' (shorter, clearer). also focus management: when you expand it should move keyboard focus into the expanded frame.
samir: export placement thought: keep export button inside the detail panel top-right so global chrome stays clean. but make it sticky so it's visible during scroll.
aria: a11y notes: error badge color appears to be #d9534f — check contrast at 14px body text; aim for AA/AAA depending on label size. add an aria-live polite region when the trace finishes loading so screen reader users know content updated.
maya: Good call. quick aria snippet for the export button I was thinking of:
```html
<button id="export-trace" aria-label="Export trace (JSON)" aria-live="polite">Export</button>
```
jonah: Implementation detail: parts of the trace are lazy-loaded (KV cache). keyboard flow must handle that — set tabindex="-1" on sections that become visible and call element.focus() after insertion so tab order doesn't skip.
samir: correlation ID UX: show primary correlation id as a pill, secondary ids inline. pill has copy icon and hover tooltip that reveals full id. we should also show a truncated form to avoid horizontal overflow.
priya: Copy button copy text should be explicit for SRs: 'Copy correlation ID' rather than just 'Copy'. that helps announcements.
aria: also: visible focus ring on the pill is required. add keyboard shortcut idea: when pill focused, pressing "c" triggers copy. include aria-describedby to point to the tooltip that explains the shortcut.
maya: UI question — when there are many roots (microservices), do we layout multiple pills horizontally? that could overflow small viewports. suggestion: compact stack with ellipsis + count e.g. +3. on click open a flyout list.
jonah: +1 to ellipsis. flyout should trap focus and be dismissable with Esc. ensure flyout is not part of document flow (role=dialog).
design-bot: Screenshot attached: mock_v3_collapsed.png :camera: (uploaded by maya)
samir: perf note for export: large traces should kick off a background streaming job and return a toast with download link when ready; don't block the UI or cause an OOM. include server-side pagination for huge spans.
priya: decision proposal: export button in top-right of panel, label 'Export trace (JSON)', stream in background, show toast with link. actions: maya to update mocks, jonah to add aria/focus handling in PR, aria to run contrast + SR checks.
maya: I'll update mocks by EOD and add both collapsed/expanded states and the flyout example. thanks all!
aria: I'll do a quick contrast pass and test with VoiceOver once mocks are in. quick aside — VoiceOver keeps reading timestamp before the main message sometimes; we might want to visually show timestamp but hide it from the SR with aria-hidden while exposing a concise accessible label for the event.
jonah: noted, I'll add a11y tests to the runtime checklist and include a small automated VoiceOver script.
maya: great — closing this thread after mocks updated. /done :white_check_mark:
